note: Reference data comes from Artificial Analysis's own leaderboard data (read directly, last on 2026-11-09): every model scoring 25 or more on its Intelligence Index, at its best effort setting, with AA's evaluations, prices, output speed and cost and time per task. The AA Coding and Agentic indexes and some provider prices are earlier hand entries from aggregators (temperature2.com, multiple.chat). Blank cells are not observed; every number carries its source and effort setting on hover.
